descriptions.text: CCV is a deflationary / fee-on-transfer token whose price on the PancakeSwap pair can be manipulated by burning tokens directly out of pool-related addresses. The attacker flash-loaned 100,000 BUSD from a DODO DPP pool and, inside DPPFlashLoanCall, invoked two unprotected functions on the project proxy contracts (0x369baafe and 0xb7da6a49) that operate on the proxies' CCV/BUSD balances. Sandwiched between a BUSD->CCV and CCV->BUSD swap (using swapExactTokensForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens), these burn/transfer calls reduced the effective CCV reserve and skewed the constant-product price so the round-trip swap returned more BUSD than it cost. The root cause is the token's flawed deflationary accounting combined with precision loss in the fee-on-transfer reserve math. Attack Tx: https://bscscan.com/tx/0x6ba4152db9da45f5751f2c083bf77d4b3385373d5660c51fe2e4382718afd9b4
